headline: What's next for Man City? Appeals, possible punishments, how long it would take
description: Man City have appealed the Premier League's guilty verdict, while the sanctions board also begins its work on figuring out appropriate punishments. So what happens next, and what is the possible timeline?

headline: Everton's Martin Sherif fined for breaching FA betting rules
description: Everton youngster Martin Sherif has been fined for breaching Football Association betting rules.

headline: Sources: Pep Guardiola set to attend first Man City home game since guilty verdict
description: Pep Guardiola is expected to attend Manchester City's Champions League fixture against Paris Saint-Germain, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Max Dowman presented with three Guinness World Records after breakout Arsenal season
description: Max Dowman has added three Guinness World Records to his growing list of achievements despite not turning 17 until this coming December.

headline: Ian Darke's early Premier League impressions for all 20 teams
description: Might Arsenal be more vulnerable than expected? Are Brighton capable of making a top-four bid? Here's what stands out from the first weeks of Premier League action.

headline: Sir Alex Ferguson: Cristiano Ronaldo and Wayne Rooney were 'the best in Europe' at Man United
description: Sir Alex Ferguson has said that Cristiano Ronaldo and Wayne Rooney were the two best players in Europe for a period under his management at Manchester United.
